faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Hindustan Machine Tools (HMT) for hiring professionals in its machine tools division on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by HMT?
faq.answer: HMT has advertised for the post of Senior Adviser (Operations) under the Operations and Management division.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies available for the Senior Adviser (Operations) post across the organization.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for HMT recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Candidates must download the form, fill it, and send it via post or courier.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of filled-in applications at the designated office address is 09 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a full-time regular Engineering Degree in Mechanical, Production, Electrical & Electronics, Electronics & Communication, or Metallurgy Engineering.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must be less than 63 years of age as of 01.09.2026 to be eligible for the Senior Adviser position.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary range offered for this post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary ranging between Rs. 55,000/- and Rs. 1,15,000/- based on profile and experience.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent via Ordinary post, Speed Post, Registered Post, or Courier to the General Manager (O&M) & Subsidiary HR Chief at HMT Bengaluru.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this job?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting eligible candidates followed by an interview conducted either in person or through video conferencing.
